title: The checkpoint
place: A Mongol road post in western Asia, about 1272.

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed. (Project Gutenberg #10636); Claude with ChatGPT (text only), 2026-11-26
findings: The tablet got them 'whatever they stood in need of'; homeward they had escorts of '200 horsemen'.
No particular checkpoint is in Polo: this scene is our dramatisation of what the tablet did.

layout.status: Draft blocking for the storyboard (Nov 26 2026); distances are a first proposal.

approved.how: standing approval, 23:25: "can you just not wait for my approval every time, and continue making all the storyboards that we need?"

landmarks.label: Mongol road post
landmarks.note: a few felt tents and a pole with a horsetail standard beside the road

cells.action: Two Mongol guards sit ON HORSEBACK side by side across the road in front of the post, blocking it, one holding a spear across; the Polos' caravan halts in front of them.

where.niccolo: the rider in red in front
where.marco-horse: Marco's mount, a red-brown chestnut, however small in the frame
where.niccolo-horse: Niccolò's mount, a black horse, however small in the frame
where.maffeo-horse: Maffeo's mount, a PALE dapple grey, however small in the frame: light grey body, darker legs, the lightest of the three horses, never dark

cells.action: Niccolò holds up the gold tablet from the saddle toward the Mongol officer: a long flat gold plate with rounded ends, as long as his forearm, held up flat to show its face (not a cup, not a box).

where.niccolo-horse: Niccolò's mount, a black horse, however small in the frame

cells.action: The Mongol officer sees the tablet and gives a respectful nod.

Post-station horses: two Mongol guards lead three fresh saddled post horses toward the Polos by the reins. These are the station's horses, plain duns and light browns, NOT the Polos' own chestnut, black and grey. The Polos stand on foot at the left, side by side, a step back; Marco watches, amazed. Keep it uncluttered: five people and three horses, all legs clear and on the ground, nobody overlapping a horse's head.

where.marco: the young man in white, left
